_about: Part 5 - overseas rollout logistics. A network-equipment vendor ships radio-access equipment from Shenzhen to network-rollout projects in seven overseas markets. Every number below is labelled REAL (public data, see data/public/rollout/sources.meta.json), SYNTHETIC (invented but documented) or ILLUSTRATIVE (a round, plausible-order-of-magnitude assumption, NOT a quote and NOT market data). No company data.

selection._note: REAL data, documented rule: rank partners by the 2024+2025 share of China's HS 851761 ('base stations') exports (UN Comtrade); keep partners that have LPI 2.0 2024 container import dwell quartiles AND aviation import dwell (mean, median) - this drops landlocked markets and those without published data (e.g. Uzbekistan, Russia, Uganda, Iran, Ukraine); take the largest eligible partner in each region. 2025 alone would pick Lebanon instead of Iraq and Argentina instead of Peru (reported in the README).

sea._speed_note: ASSUMPTION (not a cited figure): slow-steaming liner services typically sail in the mid-teens of knots; sensitivity at 14 and 18 kn.
sea._port_call_note: ILLUSTRATIVE allowance for intermediate calls of a liner loop (e.g. 8,000 nm -> +4 days).
sea._ocean_cv_note: ILLUSTRATIVE schedule variability of the port-to-port leg (gamma, coefficient of variation).
sea._transshipment_note: REAL mean: LPI 2.0 2024 'number of transshipments' n and 'time spent in transshipment' t of the destination economy, both averaged over ALL inbound containers (all origins, not only China). Model: with probability min(1, n) a transshipment happens and then lasts gamma(mean t / min(1, n), CV 0.5 - ILLUSTRATIVE). The component mean equals t.

origin_truck_days._note: ILLUSTRATIVE: Shenzhen factory/DC to Yantian gate-in.

air._flight_note: ILLUSTRATIVE: airborne time = great-circle km x 1.15 / 750 km/h (OurAirports coordinates are REAL).

origin_days._note: ILLUSTRATIVE: factory to SZX, export clearance, build-up, booking wait.

hub_days._note: ILLUSTRATIVE: one transfer at a hub airport (no direct freighter assumed).

arrival_to_nfd_days._note: ILLUSTRATIVE: arrival to 'freight notified' (warehouse check-in). LPI 2.0 aviation dwell starts at NFD.

inland_days._note: ILLUSTRATIVE, same for every market: port/airport or in-country warehouse to site.

dwell_model._container_note: Lognormal fitted to the REAL LPI 2.0 quartiles (Q1, median, Q3) of container import (destination) and export (China) dwell time: mu = mean of the three log-quartiles, sigma = ln(Q3/Q1) / (2 x 0.6745). Alternative for the sensitivity check: 'median_mean' (median and mean matched, sigma = sqrt(2 ln(mean/median))). The lognormal shape itself is an ASSUMPTION; only three or four summary statistics are published.
dwell_model._air_note: Lognormal matched to the REAL LPI 2.0 aviation import dwell median and mean. The published P80-P20 range is not used: for some economies (count in results/rollout/summary.json, data_checks) the mean is below 0.2 x (P80 - P20), which is impossible for one non-negative sample, so the three statistics cannot all describe the same distribution.

containers._source: Typical ISO dry containers, 'Intermodal container' article, Wikipedia (accessed 2026-10-21): maximum interior dimensions, typical door aperture and common net load (payload). Values vary by manufacturer; check the actual equipment.
containers._clearance_note: ASSUMPTION: a loaded stack must pass under the door aperture with 5 cm to spare.

site_kit._note: SYNTHETIC packing list of one radio-access site (three sectors). Packed dimensions (L x W x H, m), gross kg, whether the unit may sit on top of another, the load it can carry on top, and an ILLUSTRATIVE value. 'critical' units are small, high-value and flown in the split policy. No brands, no product data.

units.desc: feeders, fibre, power cable, installation material

costs._about: ILLUSTRATIVE round numbers in USD, NOT quotes. Order-of-magnitude references only: Drewry World Container Index 15 Oct 2026, composite USD 4,485 per 40ft, Shanghai-Genoa USD 3,945 (https://www.drewry.co.uk/supply-chain-advisors/supply-chain-expertise/world-container-index-assessed-by-drewry); WorldACD via AJOT, Hong Kong-Europe air spot USD 4.96/kg in week 31 of 2026 (https://www.ajot.com/news/weekly-air-cargo-trends-july-27-to-august-2-2026). Accessed 2026-10-21.
costs._air_volumetric_note: IATA general-cargo volume rule: chargeable kg = max(gross kg, cm3 / 6000), about 167 kg/m3; express couriers often use 5,000. Same convention as config/rates_illustrative.json.
costs._holding_note: Holding 25%/yr of equipment value (as Part 2) charged in transit (buyer owns goods in transit) and while waiting early at an in-country warehouse; storage per m3-day while waiting.

schedule._note: SYNTHETIC rollout: 6 sites per week for 12 weeks in each market; the sites of one week share a need date.
